entities.name: Sidelink Common Control Information Procedure
entities.description: Procedure for handling sidelink common control information carried by MasterInformationBlockSidelink, which applies to both sidelink communication and discovery.

entities.name: MasterInformationBlockSidelink
entities.description: Message that carries sidelink common control information for NR sidelink communication and discovery.

entities.name: Sidelink Common Control Information
entities.description: Common control information for sidelink communication and discovery carried in MasterInformationBlockSidelink.

entities.name: UE has selected SyncRef UE
entities.description: Condition where the UE has a selected synchronization reference UE as specified in clause 5.8.6.

entities.name: Valid MasterInformationBlockSidelink
entities.description: Property indicating the UE maintains a valid version of the MasterInformationBlockSidelink message from its SyncRef UE.

entities.name: UE configured for NR sidelink
entities.description: Condition where the UE is configured to receive or transmit NR sidelink communication or discovery.

relations.description: MasterInformationBlockSidelink message carries the sidelink common control information.
The sidelink common control procedure involves handling the MasterInformationBlockSidelink message.
The procedure applies to UEs configured for NR sidelink communication/discovery.
If the UE has a selected SyncRef UE, it must ensure having a valid MasterInformationBlockSidelink message.
